cache.intro: Public pages are rendered on the server and kept for a while so they are not rebuilt on every visit. They refresh on their own when their data changes (a sync, an edit in this dashboard); here you can check that and force it.
cache.render-description: Renders every public page and keeps the result in memory. It is emptied on every deploy.
cache.render-unreachable: Not responding. Pages are being served without it, or not served at all.
cache.render-not-configured: Not linked to the dashboard in this environment (PAGE_CACHE_URL and PAGE_CACHE_TOKEN are missing in ff-api).
cache.cloudflare-description: The network in front of the site. If it stores pages, it serves them without the request reaching the server.
cache.cloudflare-linked: Every purge is also sent to Cloudflare, for the same pages.
cache.cloudflare-not-linked: Purges do not reach Cloudflare (CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN are missing in ff-api). It only matters if a rule there stores pages.
cache.no-entries: No pages are stored: they will be stored as they are visited.
cache.no-matches: No stored page matches the search.
cache.more-entries: And {{count}} more. Use the search to see them.
cache.purge-all-confirm: Every stored page is removed, here and at Cloudflare if it is linked. They will be rendered again as they are visited; the first visits will take a little longer.
cache.purged: Purged. Pages removed from the server: {{count}}.
cache.load-error: The cache could not be queried
cache.load-error-description: Please try again in a moment.
cache.data-description: Public API responses, stored in Redis. Used by the page server and by navigation within the site.
cache.data-active: Stored in “{{store}}”. Purged together with the pages, except when purging a single page.
cache.data-inactive: Not stored: the cache store (“{{store}}”) does not support tags. With CACHE_STORE=redis it does.

link.title: Link with {{provider}}
link.search-help: Search {{provider}} for the competition by name or country («la liga», «spain»), or type its id. Each search uses one request of the daily quota.
link.no-results: No results. Try the English name or the country.
link.done: Linked with {{name}}. You can sync it now.
link.unlink-confirm: It will no longer be synced with this provider and its data sources will be removed. What was already imported (seasons, matches, teams, players) is kept.
link.unlink-entity-confirm: The next sync will not recognise it: if the provider brings it, a new one will be created instead of updating this one.
link.external-id-hint: The number the provider uses to identify it.
link.manual-help: Link it if it existed before syncing: the sync will then update it instead of creating another one. The id cannot already be used by another one.
link.competition-elsewhere-title: Competitions are linked from their card
link.competition-elsewhere: In the Sync tab you can search for it in the provider and choose which data to bring.
link.intro: Which id each provider uses for our data. The sync links what matters by itself; what shows as not linked was created by hand or is no longer brought by the provider.
link.entities-help: Filter by the ones not linked to review them. Open one to link it with its id at the provider.
